query: SELECT products.product_id, products.price_cents FROM products WHERE products.product_id IN ($1, $2)
SELECT customers.customer_id, customers.email FROM customers WHERE customers.customer_id = $1
SELECT addresses.address_id, addresses.customer_id, addresses.city FROM addresses WHERE addresses.address_id = $1
INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, shipping_address_id, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING orders.order_id
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, line_no, product_id, quantity) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
SELECT orders.order_id, orders.status FROM orders WHERE orders.order_id = $1
UPDATE orders SET status=$1 WHERE orders.order_id = $2
SELECT orders.order_id, orders.status FROM orders WHERE orders.order_id = $1
UPDATE products SET price_cents=$1 WHERE products.product_id = $2
SELECT o.order_id, a.city FROM orders o JOIN addresses a ON a.address_id = o.shipping_address_id LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = $1 AND s.shipment_id IS NULL
INSERT INTO shipments (order_id, carrier, shipped_at) VALUES ($1, $2, now())
UPDATE orders SET status = $1 WHERE order_id = $2
INSERT INTO audit_log (entity, entity_id, action, at) SELECT $1, order_id, $2, now() FROM orders WHERE order_id = $3
DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE at < now() - interval '90 days'
SELECT oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price_cents, o.placed_at FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.placed_at >= now() - interval '1 day'
UPDATE customers SET email = $1 WHERE customer_id = $2
INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, email, name, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (customer_id) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email
